title: Re-pointing a received vendor bill line does not offer an inactive part
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), a role that has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Create & Edit' and 'Delete'.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BILL-01), with description {Description-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL BILL PART A), is tracked at {Location-A} with 4 in its default bin and is inactive.
  • Inventory part {Part-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BILL-02), with description {Description-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL BILL PART B), is tracked at {Location-A} with 4 in its default bin and is active.
  • Vendor bill {Vendor-bill-A} (for example invoice ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BILL-INV) from vendor {Vendor-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL BILL Vendor) is received and has one line for vendor part {Number-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BILL-VEND-01).
custom_steps:
1. Go to Parts → Vendor Invoices and open {Vendor-bill-A}.
  2. On the {Number-A} line open the control that changes which part the line points to.
  3. Type "ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BILL-0" (the start that {Part-A} and {Part-B} share) in its part lookup.
  4. Close the lookup without picking anything.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: {Part-B} is offered and {Part-A} is not.
  • Step 4: The line still points to {Number-A}.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S9-R6, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas 13 Oct copy: no board shows a vendor bill.
